message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. Two large, caricatured men in dark suits are crouched on either side of a narrow turquoise waterway. The man on the left wears round glasses, while the man on the right has a wide face and narrow eyes. Both place their hands on small, toy-like cargo ships floating in the water. The ships have dark hulls and white rectangular structures on top. Behind the two main figures, three silhouetted human forms stand in the background against a dark, moody environment.

At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is prominent. Above it, text reads "Berebut Panggung Pembebasan Pilot Susi Air H.26" and "Bandar Besar Narkotik dari Balik Penjara H.88". Below the title, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is visible. Central text reads "BOHIR-BOHIR PASIR DI LAUT" followed by a paragraph in Indonesian and "H.66". In the top right, there is a date, price, website, barcode, and QR code. The lighting focuses on the central figures and the water, casting long shadows.
